summary.text: Adele McClure is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 2, representing part of Arlington County, serving since January 10, 2024. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Public Safety (vice chair), General Laws, and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Adele Y. McClure was born in Yuma, Arizona, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says she earned a B.S. in economics from Virginia Commonwealth University in 2011 and lists her occupation as vice president, issue advocacy.
The profile lists her memberships as the Arlington Commission on Aging and the Pay Our Interns board.
